source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if present LED function works normally

1. Insert NVMe SSD into BP slot and check present LED

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Check system spec define LED function

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Generic Locate-LED command plus operator confirmation.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: LED command result and physical observation.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; recognizes visual confirmation but incorrectly offers Locate as a Present/power LED stimulus and defaults enclosure 0.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds physical insertion, hot-plug safety, drive/slot identity, specification and photo/video evidence.

original_test_intent: Verify that inserting the approved NVMe SSD into the specified backplane slot produces the chassis present/power LED state defined by the platform specification and does not introduce storage or management faults.
original_method: A qualified operator follows the platform's powered or powered-off insertion procedure, inserts the identified SSD into the mapped slot, directly observes and records the physical present indicator, while the agent correlates drive enumeration and controller/BMC events to that slot and time.
manual_activity: Physical SSD insertion and direct visual confirmation of the chassis indicator are the core acceptance actions. Machine inventory may corroborate presence but cannot perform or attest either action, so V3.1 requires MANUAL ONLY.
required_inputs: Platform/backplane present-LED specification, color/state/timing and exceptions
Chassis bay, backplane port, enclosure and controller slot mapping
SSD model/serial/firmware and proof that the chosen insertion state is supported
Operator access, ESD handling, camera/KVM timing and recovery procedure
Controller/OS/BMC read-only commands validated for this topology
safety_requirements: Do not insert into an energized slot unless the platform explicitly supports NVMe hot plug for that bay.
Confirm the selected SSD and slot are not boot, active data, protected or unknown resources.
Use ESD and mechanical alignment controls; stop on resistance, power, thermal, fault-LED or enumeration anomaly.
Never initialize, format or write the inserted drive as part of this presence test.
Do not issue Locate as a substitute for Present; do not retry insertion automatically.
agent_execution_scope: Validate drive-slot mapping and capture controller/OS/BMC baseline.
Timestamp enumeration and event evidence around the operator's insertion.
Correlate the observed physical bay with the same SSD serial and report discrepancies.
Organize photos/logs and Tool Result without claiming the LED observation or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve and physically insert the SSD under the correct power/ESD procedure.
Observe and record the exact Present LED against the specification.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not equivalent: a Locate command tests a separately controlled locator LED, not the hardware-driven presence/power indication, and its enclosure fallback is unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Keep physical insertion/visual evidence as primary; use only read-only inventory and event collection to correlate the inserted SSD and slot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NVMe insertion, backplane Present LED check and 5/5-minute fields remain unchanged.

modernized_recommendation.status: MANUAL VISUAL TEST WITH IDENTITY CORRELATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed bay map, synchronized photo/video timestamp and pre/post SSD-serial enumeration so the human LED observation is tied to the exact hardware event.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact chassis, NVMe backplane, controller and LED wiring/firmware.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record backplane/CPLD/BMC/controller firmware and OS driver/tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform LED behavior and NVMe hot-plug service documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds traceable identity and event correlation without replacing physical observation.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Platform-specific Present LED truth table and slot map.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Controller LED state or software presence cannot prove the visible indicator's color, brightness, location or behavior.

project_override_considerations: The project defines the tested bay, insertion power state and expected LED. An override may narrow the population but must not replace Present with Locate or omit direct observation.
expected_evidence: Specification excerpt, SSD serial/model, bay/enclosure/slot map and hot-plug approval
Operator-attributed timestamped before/during/after photo or video of the Present LED
Matching controller/OS enumeration and BMC/SEL/storage events
Post-test health, deviations, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion both defer expected Present behavior to the system specification. The absent truth table is a required input, not a contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intended physical/visual check is clear. Missing slot and LED specifications affect readiness and do not make the library case permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects its Locate substitution and controller/slot assumptions while retaining supplemental inventory.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps its physical safety and identity controls but applies MANUAL ONLY because observation is core acceptance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Defines machine evidence as corroboration only and protects the semantic distinction between Present and Locate.

review_improvement: Prevents a successful LED-control command from being reported as a physical presence-indicator result.
independent_technical_reasoning: Present LED behavior is driven by actual insertion and accepted through visual chassis evidence. Those are irreducibly human in this review environment; automation remains support, not the test core.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat insertion, toggle an unrelated LED or move to another bay automatically after mismatch. Preserve the observed state and request engineer direction.
